control_the_fireface_800s_stand: Control the Fireface 800’s stand-alone mixer from your Mac. Plain MIDI, no FireWire.
download_on_the_mac_app: Download on the Mac App Store (opens in a new tab)
download_on_the_mac_app_2: Download on the Mac App Store
set_every_send_into_every: Set every send into every submix and the output faders the unit exposes over MIDI. Drag, scroll or type a value and the unit glides there on its own, click-free.
place_every_input_in_each: Place every input in each submix, on the unit’s own pan law.
silence_an_input_across_every: Silence an input across every submix at once.
phantom_power_for_mic_7: Phantom power for Mic 7–10, with a check before a recall flips it.
save_named_mixes_and_recall: Save named mixes and recall them. The power-on state is kept too.
dim_or_mute_the_monitor: Dim or mute the monitor and phones pairs you choose.
run_more_than_one_fireface: Run more than one Fireface 800, each with its own ports and snapshots.
newest_first_or_by_name: Newest first or by name, with As booted, the mix the unit powered on with. Recall names the +48 V switches it would flip before anything goes out.
state_what_48_v_and: State what +48 V and the instrument options power on with. Choose reference levels and the clock once, and the app puts them on the unit at every connect.
the_app_talks_to_the: The app talks to the unit’s stand-alone mixer over plain MIDI. It does not replace TotalMix: no EQ, no dynamics, no metering.
macos_13_to_macos_27: macOS 13 to macOS 27 Golden Gate<small>Apple silicon; Intel up to Tahoe</small>
midi_interface_any_usb_midi: MIDI interface<small>Any USB-MIDI interface with in and out</small>

connect_your_fireface_800_over: Connect your Fireface 800 over a MIDI interface.
stuck_visit_our_faq_or: Stuck? Visit our FAQ or write to support.
download_the_app_and_start: Download the app and start the trial inside it. No account, no card. After the trial, a one-time purchase, no subscription.
